meta.measure: MTA hourly subway ridership estimate (entries), not OD
meta.method: Sum all 12 monthly hourly-entry cubes by year/complex/weekday/hour; divide by annual occurrences of that weekday; normalize the 168-cell representative week. Source dow Sunday=0 is converted to Monday=0.
meta.sparse_assumption: Absent cells inside the validated complete annual acquisition contribute zero; missing years or months are rejected.
meta.scope: 424 complexes shared with the map; unavailable profiles remain null. Other source complexes are accounted separately.
meta.usage: Right-column historical comparison only. Both compared years must come from this hourly-entry source whenever the base is 2019 or 2020. The OD map is unchanged.
